children: Bain Capital GSS Investment reported net income in the quarter, compared with a net loss in the prior-year quarter, as $4.5M of interest earned on trust-account deposits was partly offset by $244,145 in general and administrative costs. The company said it has not begun operations and does not expect operating revenue until after a business combination.
: Interest-bearing demand deposits held in the trust account totaled $477.7M at September 30, 2026.
: The company had not selected a target and said it had not engaged in substantive discussions with any target.
: Cash was $622,015 and working capital was $48,496 at September 30, 2026.
: Management cited substantial doubt about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern, with mandatory liquidation if no combination is completed by October 1, 2027.
